params.name: picture
params.description: In: source picture to be transformed. Out: resulting picture after transformation (the source picture is modified directly).

sentinelValues.meaning: Reset: undoes all matrix operations (scale, flip, translate, ...) carried out on the picture; no param1-4 used
Scale: param1/param2 are horizontal/vertical resize factors (e.g. 1.5 to enlarge width by 50%, 0.5 to reduce height by 50%)
Translate: param1/param2 are horizontal/vertical pixel offsets (positive = right/down, negative = left/up)
Flip horizontally: no param1-4 used; any prior translation is not taken into account
Flip vertically: no param1-4 used; any prior translation is not taken into account
Crop: param1/param2 are the X/Y origin (pixels) and param3/param4 are the width/height of the cropped picture; not reversible
Fade to grey scale: no param1-4 used; not reversible
Transparency: param1 is a hexadecimal RGB color (e.g. 0x00FFFFFF for white, the default if param1 is omitted) whose matching pixels become transparent; not reversible

params.name: param1
params.description: First transformation parameter; meaning depends on operator (see operator's sentinelValues)

params.name: param2
params.description: Second transformation parameter; meaning depends on operator (see operator's sentinelValues)

params.name: param3
params.description: Third transformation parameter; meaning depends on operator (see operator's sentinelValues), used only by Crop

params.name: param4
params.description: Fourth transformation parameter; meaning depends on operator (see operator's sentinelValues), used only by Crop

jointConstraints.rule: The number and meaning of param1-param4 actually used depends entirely on operator: Reset/Flip horizontally/Flip vertically/Fade to grey scale use none of them; Scale/Translate use param1-param2; Transparency uses only param1; Crop uses all of param1-param4.

constraints: Transformations do not change the picture's underlying type (e.g. a vectorial picture remains vectorial after transformation).
Scale, Translate, Flip horizontally, and Flip vertically are cancellable (reversible via the opposite operation or Reset); Crop, Fade to grey scale, and Transparency are not.
